note: Viral shot grammar as method cards. Consumed by the Synthex card composer alongside the existing method-cards/modifier-chips. nexus-viral supplies these; it does not replace the base cards.

cards.label: Viral hero short (9:16)
cards.intent: hook-first short-form built to survive thumb-stop, hook, and mid-drop

beats.rule: pattern interrupt on frame 1; motion/face/claim, no logo, no fade
single promise or tension, spoken + burned caption (from nexus-copywriter)
resolve hook, seed rewatch/comment, loop back to frame 1

cards.label: Pattern-interrupt open
cards.intent: first-frame scroll stopper usable as a cover thumbnail

cards.label: 3-beat retention
cards.intent: new information every ~1.5s; no dead middle
cards.rule: each beat introduces one new fact/face/cut/caption reveal; cut on motion not silence

cards.label: Loop-back close
cards.rule: last frame hands back to first where format allows; resolve the hook, don't bury it under a CTA
